recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic night scene featuring three male figures in formal attire walking toward the viewer on a rain-slicked city street, each holding a black umbrella. The background is a dense, glowing metropolis filled with neon signs, billboards, and marquee lights, creating a high-contrast environment of bright artificial light against a dark, rainy atmosphere.
coreVisualRelationships: The figures are grounded by long, dark reflections on the wet asphalt.
The neon signs frame the subjects, creating a vibrant halo effect around their dark silhouettes.
The repetition of the three umbrellas creates a rhythmic horizontal line across the center.
coreInvariants: Wet, reflective ground texture with puddles
High-contrast lighting between the dark foreground and glowing background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three full-body figures positioned in the lower-middle ground, scaled to occupy approximately one-third of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure and the large glowing crest directly behind him.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Leading lines from the street perspective draw the eye from the bottom corners toward the center figures, then upward to the vertical neon signs.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Concentrated in the dark sky between buildings and the lower foreground street area.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated charcoal and cool grays in the street and sky.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red and warm amber from the neon billboards.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cool cyan and electric white from marquee lights and reflections.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast; saturated colors are restricted to light sources and their immediate reflections.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mix of sans-serif, slab-serif, and cursive script
letterConstructionRules: Blocky, illuminated marquee style for headers
characterSpecificRedesigns: Text following the perspective of building facades
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of rigid geometric sans-serifs with fluid, organic neon scripts.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean, modern geometric base for marquee headers.
Captures the fluid, illuminated signage look of the left-side billboard.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a wide-angle night cityscape inspired by Times Square in the rain. Include wet asphalt with colorful reflections, misty atmosphere, and numerous glowing billboards and neon signs on tall buildings. In the middle ground, place three men in dark suits holding black umbrellas, walking toward the camera. Leave the billboard areas blank or with generic light patterns for text overlay.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom neon-style typography onto the blank billboards. Use a bold, glowing sans-serif for the central top sign and a flowing, illuminated script for the large red billboard on the left. Ensure all text follows the perspective of the buildings and casts a glow onto the surrounding environment.

verificationChecks: Reflections on ground match billboard colors
Umbrellas are solid black with slight highlights

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic light bloom around neon sources.
Ensure the three figures are distinct and not merged.
Verify that the ground reflections align vertically with the light sources.
Confirm the rain streaks are subtle and don't obscure the subjects.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject Trio] with [Rainy Urban Night] using [Neon Signage] as the primary light source and [Wet Asphalt] for compositional symmetry.
